Aluminium is extracted from its ore by electrolysis using carbon electrodes.
Aluminium, oxygen and carbon dioxide are all produced during this process.
Which statement about this process is correct?
A
Reduction of oxide ions happens at the carbon anode.
B
Reduction of oxygen gas happens at the carbon anode.
C
Reduction of oxide ions happens at the carbon cathode.
D
Reduction of oxygen gas happens at the carbon cathode.

options.label: A
options.text: Reduction of oxide ions happens at the carbon anode.

options.label: B
options.text: Reduction of oxygen gas happens at the carbon anode.

options.label: C
options.text: Reduction of oxide ions happens at the carbon cathode.

options.label: D
options.text: Reduction of oxygen gas happens at the carbon cathode.
